name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
summary: A single-leg hip hinge that loads the hamstrings and glutes and challenges balance and trunk control. Light weights are enough to make it hard.
setup: Hold a dumbbell in one or both hands in front of your thighs.
Stand on one leg with a soft bend in the standing knee. Keep a hand near a wall or chair for balance when learning.
Keep your hips and shoulders square to the floor.
execution: Hinge at the hip and send your free leg straight back behind you as your torso lowers.
Keep your back flat and the dumbbell close to your standing leg.
Lower until your torso is near parallel to the floor or you feel a stretch in the hamstring of the standing leg.
Squeeze the glute and drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
cues: Long line from head to heel
mistakes: Rotating the hips open: keep both hip bones facing the floor.
Rounding the back: shorten the range and keep the spine long.
Losing balance: fix your eyes on a point on the floor and use a wall for support.
Locking the standing knee: keep it softly bent.
